tools.name: ascora_list_customers
tools.description: Search Ascora customers (sites and billing customers): id, number, name, contact, email, phone, addresses, on-hold flags, customer type, lead source, billing customer and assigned user. GET /Customers/Customers.

tools.name: ascora_get_customer
tools.description: One Ascora customer by id (GUID from ascora_list_customers), including custom fields. GET /Customers/Customer/{id}.

tools.name: ascora_list_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts across all customers by name, email or phone. GET /Customers/Contacts.

tools.name: ascora_list_customer_contacts
tools.description: All contacts of one customer, with role and default-contact flag. GET /Customers/GetContactsForCustomer/{customerId}.

tools.name: ascora_list_supplies
tools.description: Search the inventory price list: materials and services with part number, description, cost, sell price ex/inc tax, supplier, categories and reorder flags. Use the supply id to add items to quotes. GET /Inventory/Supplies.

tools.name: ascora_list_kits
tools.description: Search kits (bundles of supplies and labour) with part number, description, markup, sell price and pricing method. GET /Inventory/Kits.

tools.name: ascora_list_categories
tools.description: Inventory categories (Category 1 or 2, top-level or sub-categories) used to filter supplies and kits. GET /Inventory/Categories.

tools.name: ascora_list_labour_roles
tools.description: Labour roles with their hourly rate ex tax, ordered by name. Use the role id to add labour to a quote. GET /Quotes/LabourRoles.

tools.name: ascora_list_quotes
tools.description: Search quotes: number, name, status, date, totals ex/inc tax, pricing method, job type and site/billing customer. Status defaults to OPEN (in progress or sent) when omitted. GET /Quotes/Quotes.

tools.name: ascora_get_quote
tools.description: One quote by its full number (e.g. Q57): status, dates, totals, pricing method, addresses, job type, customers and custom fields. GET /Quotes/Quote/{quoteNumber}.

tools.name: ascora_list_jobs
tools.description: Search jobs: number, name, status, totals, pricing method, job type, site/billing customer, secondary status and pipeline phase. Status defaults to OPEN when omitted. GET /Jobs/Jobs.

tools.name: ascora_get_job
tools.description: One job by its full number (e.g. J112): status, dates, totals, pricing method, job type, customers, secondary status and pipeline phase. A deleted job reads as not found. GET /Jobs/Job/{jobNumber}.

tools.name: ascora_get_job_labour
tools.description: Labour lines on a job: role, hours, hourly rate, totals, staff member, chargeable and invoiced flags. GET /Jobs/JobLabour/{jobNumber}.

tools.name: ascora_get_job_timesheets
tools.description: Timesheet entries on a job: staff member, start/end, hours, meal break and payroll-sent flag (pay and cost rates are not returned). GET /Jobs/JobTimesheets/{jobNumber}.

tools.name: ascora_list_bookings
tools.description: Search the schedule: bookings of jobs, quotes and activities with staff member, start/end, notes, arrival window and the job or quote they belong to. Archived bookings are excluded unless include_archived. GET /Bookings/Bookings.

tools.name: ascora_get_booking
tools.description: One booking by id: type, times (local and UTC), staff member, job/quote/activity, customers, address, notes, arrival window, rates and reminder flags. GET /Bookings/Booking/{bookingId}.

tools.name: ascora_list_activity_types
tools.description: Activity types that non-job bookings (training, leave-style activities, etc.) can be made with. GET /Bookings/ActivityTypes.

tools.name: ascora_list_users
tools.description: Staff users of the Ascora company (archived users excluded): id, name, email, mobile, job title, team, scheduler group, licence and access flags. Pay rates are not returned. GET /Users/Users.

tools.name: ascora_list_suppliers
tools.description: Search suppliers by name, supplier number or exact business number (ABN). GET /Suppliers/Suppliers.

tools.name: ascora_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: Search supplier invoices and credit notes: supplier, dates, tracking number, lines and totals. GET /SupplierInvoices/SupplierInvoices.

tools.name: ascora_create_enquiry
tools.description: WRITE: create a new enquiry (lead) in Ascora. Every call creates another enquiry (not idempotent; Ascora allows 500 enquiries an hour per company), so do not repeat it. Needs at least a name, company, email, phone or mobile. POST /Enquiry.

tools.name: ascora_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer (site or billing) in Ascora. Always creates a new record (it never updates an existing customer), so search with ascora_list_customers first to avoid duplicates. A customer type or lead source name that does not exist is created. POST /Customers/Customer.

tools.name: ascora_add_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an enquiry, job, quote, invoice or customer (the entity must already exist). Notes cannot be edited or removed through this server, and every call adds another note. POST /Notes/Note.

tools.name: ascora_create_quote
tools.description: WRITE: create a new quote (status In Progress; it is NOT sent to the customer) for a site customer, optionally with supplies, kits and labour from the price list. Ids that Ascora cannot find are skipped silently when creating, so check the totals in the reply. Every call creates another quote. POST

tools.name: ascora_update_quote_status
tools.description: WRITE: change a quote's status to IN-PROGRESS, SENT-TO-CUSTOMER, LOST or WON. WON converts the quote into a new Job (the same as ascora_convert_quote_to_job; a second WON returns the existing job). Ascora's reference documents only a status change, not an email to the customer. POST /Quotes/UpdateSt

tools.name: ascora_convert_quote_to_job
tools.description: WRITE: convert a quote into a Job (what Convert to Job does in Ascora): supplies, labour, notes, bookings and attachments carry over and the quote is marked converted. Never forces a new job: a variation quote is added onto its original job, a quote whose job still exists is reconnected to it, and a

tools.name: ascora_create_job
tools.description: WRITE: create a new job for a site customer (it never updates an existing job). Every call creates another job; add work with a quote or in Ascora. The job is not booked and nothing is sent to the customer. POST /Jobs/Job.

tools.name: ascora_create_booking
tools.description: WRITE: schedule staff on a job or a quote (give exactly one of job_number / quote_number). One booking is created per staff member and the job or quote moves to Booked; the bookings show on the Scheduler and the staff mobile apps, and Ascora's own reminder settings may notify the customer or staff.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "ascora_create_customer" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.detail: Description of "ascora_create_quote" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ascora_list_customers, ascora_list_contacts, ascora_list_users, ascora_create_customer, ascora_create_quote · Private data: ascora_list_customers, ascora_list_contacts, ascora_list_customer_contacts, ascora_create_customer, ascora_update_quote_status · Public sink: ascora_list_customers, ascora_list_contacts, ascora_list_users, ascora_create_enquiry, ascora_create_customer, ascora_add_note, ascora_create_quote, ascora_update_quote_status, ascora_convert_quote_to_job, ascora_create_job, ascora_create_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ascora_list_customers, ascora_list_contacts, ascora_list_users, ascora_create_customer, ascora_create_quote · Private data: ascora_list_customers, ascora_list_contacts, ascora_list_customer_contacts, ascora_create_customer, ascora_update_quote_status · Public sink: ascora_list_customers, ascora_list_contacts, ascora_list_users, ascora_create_enquiry, ascora_create_customer, ascora_add_note, ascora_create_quote, ascora_update_quote_status, ascora_convert_quote_to_job, ascora_create_job, ascora_create_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
